body.label: Target
body.html: Self and an optional adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn. Choose one target to reduce its next incoming Damage by 1 in that time.

surges.html: The ally may move 1 unit toward you.
Both targets receive the Damage reduction.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or an adjacent willing ally would be pushed: reduce that push by 1 unit. This does not require another ally.
